responsibility: Provides inline C intrinsics for Power ISA 3.0 atomic memory operation instructions on 64-bit Power9-class systems. It defines enums for LWAT/LDAT and STWAT/STDAT sub-opcodes and wraps the underlying instructions in typed inline helpers for atomic fetch-modify-return and store-only operations on 32- and 64-bit words, serving as the programmer-facing header for these specialized rs6000 atomics.
